title: Implement a 2-Layer Neural Network Forward Pass
description: Compute the full forward pass from matrix inputs through ReLU activation and Softmax output.
problemStatement: Implement a function `forward_pass(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)` in Python using NumPy. Step 1: compute Z1 = X @ W1 + b1. Step 2: compute A1 = ReLU(Z1). Step 3: compute Z2 = A1 @ W2 + b2. Step 4: compute output probabilities P using Softmax across each row: P_i = exp(Z2_i) / sum(exp(Z2_i)). Return P.
hints: For numerically stable Softmax: shift = Z2 - np.max(Z2, axis=1, keepdims=True); exp_s = np.exp(shift); P = exp_s / np.sum(exp_s, axis=1, keepdims=True).
expectedOutput: (2, 2) array of probabilities summing to 1.0 along axis 1
solutionCode:
import numpy as np

def forward_pass(X, W1, b1, W2, b2):
    Z1 = np.dot(X, W1) + b1
    A1 = np.maximum(0, Z1)
    Z2 = np.dot(A1, W2) + b2
    exp_z = np.exp(Z2 - np.max(Z2, axis=1, keepdims=True))
    P = exp_z / np.sum(exp_z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return P

X = np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [-1.0, 0.5]])
W1 = np.array([[0.5, -0.2], [0.1, 0.8]])
b1 = np.array([0.1, -0.1])
W2 = np.array([[0.7, 0.2], [-0.4, 0.6]])
b2 = np.array([0.0, 0.0])
print(forward_pass(X, W1, b1, W2, b2).round(3))
